from collections import Counter

def largest_number(s):
    # Ignore any non-digit characters in the string
    digit_count = Counter(list(filter(str.isdigit, s))
    # Get maximum value and its count from the Counter object
    largest_num = max(digit_count.values())
    largest_val = int(largest_num[0])
    return largest_val

numbers = input()

result = largest_number(numbers)
print(result)
